face_danger.name: Face Danger
face_danger.trigger: When you attempt something risky or react to an imminent threat, envision your action and roll.
face_danger.weak_hit: You succeed, but face a troublesome cost. Choose one.
face_danger.miss: You fail, or your progress is undermined by a dramatic and costly turn of events. Pay the Price.

options.lose_momentum: You are delayed, lose advantage, or face a new danger: suffer -1 momentum.
options.endure_harm: You are tired or hurt: Endure Harm (1 harm).
options.endure_stress: You are dispirited or afraid: Endure Stress (1 stress).

secure_an_advantage.name: Secure an Advantage
secure_an_advantage.trigger: When you assess a situation, make preparations, or attempt to gain leverage, envision your action and roll.
secure_an_advantage.weak_hit: Your advantage is short-lived. Take +1 momentum.
secure_an_advantage.miss: You fail or your assumptions betray you. Pay the Price.

options.add_bonus: Gain an edge: add +1 on your next move (not a progress move).

fulfill_your_vow.name: Fulfill Your Vow
fulfill_your_vow.trigger: When you achieve what you believe to be the fulfillment of your vow, roll the challenge dice and compare to your progress.
fulfill_your_vow.strong_hit: Your quest is complete. Mark experience.
fulfill_your_vow.weak_hit: There is more to be done or you realize the truth of your quest. Mark experience, minus one.
fulfill_your_vow.miss: Your quest is undone. Pay the Price.

reach_a_milestone.name: Reach a Milestone
reach_a_milestone.trigger: When you make significant progress in your quest, mark progress on that vow.
